## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover the change or the reason they are not needed is explained.
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` pass.
- [ ] `uv run pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples are updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, customer data, internal-only URLs, or generated artifacts are included.

## Security and privacy

Describe any effect on authentication, authorization, billing, logging, data retention, provider routing, confidential-compute guarantees, or supply-chain controls. Write “none” when there is no effect.
